summary.text: Jay Costa is a Democrat who has served in the Pennsylvania Senate since May 13, 1996, representing the 43rd Senatorial District in part of Allegheny County; he has been Minority Leader since 2011.

paragraphs.text: Costa's official biography lists an A.S. from the Community College of Allegheny County (1977), a B.A. from Indiana University of Pennsylvania (1979), and a J.D. from Duquesne University School of Law (1989). He was Allegheny County Register of Wills from January 1992 to May 1996 and is a shareholder and principal at Dickie, McCamey & Chilcote P.C. in Pittsburgh.

In the Senate he was Minority Caucus Chairman from 2005 to 2008 and Minority Appropriations Committee Chair from 2009 to 2010 before being elected Minority Leader in 2011. He is also listed as a member of the University of Pittsburgh Board of Trustees and is married to Roxanne.
